task.internal_usage: Unavailable internal agent details remain unknown. Native totals may include internal work; do not add the same usage twice.
task.section.inputs: Actual sent prompt and input package
task.section.communication: Messages sent or addressed to this request

p14.title: P14 continuation and handover
p14.manual: Wait for a human decision at every P14
p14.help: MAIN continues within the original goal and existing allowance. Stop at the next P14 finishes this round; Pause now stops new dispatch immediately.
p14.waiting: Waiting for your explicit decision at P14. Automatic mode cannot clear this stop.
p14.pending: Saved: MAIN will wait for you at the next P14 whose continuation has not committed.
concurrency.policy: Each harness instance has 8 stage CLI slots; all projects share 20. Survey runs one step at a time. MAIN and native internal delegation do not occupy these slots.
round.automatic_help: TRH and FDH begin with their own Astra Ultra MAIN. MAIN chooses stages, dependencies, concurrency, communication and delivery using the full method handbook. Survey follows its fixed sequential steps.
round.human_next: Review the saved progress and decide whether to continue, pause or end. This does not certify the mathematics.
main.fixed_policy: Independent per-instance MAIN: Astra Ultra; native delegation unrestricted by PMRS
main.worker_policy: Stage CLI tasks use the stage / role / purpose policy below.
guide.start.4: TRH first sends the full P0–P13 and P14 method to its own MAIN. MAIN decides the first research task and every later dispatch from the original target and actual evidence.
guide.start.5: FDH MAIN uses D1–D5 dynamically within D0 boundaries. Survey has no MAIN and follows fixed sequential steps; knowledge-only mode ends at its knowledge snapshot.
guide.observe.4: Every P13/P14 saves a readable round report. TRH defaults to automatic continuation within the original goal and remaining allowance. Choose manual P14 or request Stop at the next P14 to take over. Completion, OPEN, budget exhaustion and software blocking remain distinct.
guide.main.2: Each TRH/FDH instance has its own gpt-6-astra Ultra MAIN. PMRS does not limit native internal delegation or charge it stage slots. PMRS top-level calls use the existing finite allowance; actual internal usage is recorded when visible. Reading this panel makes no model calls.
guide.main.3: MAIN can communicate with every stage task and change planned task-to-task links. Actual scientific exposure is retained; influenced checks cannot count as independent votes. Task details show original inputs, outputs, repairs, messages, deliveries and usage.
guide.budget.1: The finite allowance covers PMRS top-level MAIN, stage, review, repair and report calls. Each harness has 8 stage slots and all projects share 20. Survey is serial. MAIN and native internal delegation are outside stage slots; PMRS imposes no extra internal quota.
guide.start.3: The method graph explains scientific duties and actual activity. Selecting a stage opens its evidence, without scheduling it. MAIN decides the harness task graph from your goal and saved evidence.
stage.P14.name: Continuation decision
stage.P14.description: MAIN may continue within the original goal and remaining allowance; a pending stop or manual mode hands control to the user.
stage.MAIN_TRH.name: TRH MAIN researcher
stage.MAIN_FDH.name: FDH MAIN researcher
stage.MAIN_TRH.description: Uses the full P0–P13 and P14 research method to decide research tasks, dependencies, communication and delivery within the original target.
stage.MAIN_FDH.description: Uses D1–D5 dynamically within the D0 phenomenon, fixed background and permitted exploration axes.
goal.no_evidence: No saved native Goal association or client receipt is available yet.
goal.no_observation: No actual client Goal observation is saved. The requested state is not proof of successful synchronization.
goal.mirror_notice: Requested control and observed native execution are separate records. Pending or failed sync cannot resume research.
goal.receipts: Thread / Goal association and raw synchronization evidence
memory.not_proof: This is research memory and decision evidence. Mathematical qualification still depends on the referenced arguments and checks.
memory.immutable: Only published, immutable MAIN research checkpoints appear here. Store replay caches are separate and do not count as research audits.
memory.none: No published MAIN research checkpoint has been saved.
guidance.scope_note: Original words, current summary and actual delivery remain distinct. Reading, discussing or adding materials while paused does not authorize resuming research.
guidance.no_summary: No published effective-guidance summary yet. Original directions remain visible below.
audit.clock_note: The default 30-minute check is host observation, not paid analysis. A full MAIN audit becomes due after about four hours of effective research since the last completed full audit. Parallel agent time is not added. Pauses and pure external waits freeze this clock.
audit.clock: Effective research clock, due events and delay reasons
audit.control_events: Host checks and pending audit events
audit.trigger_evidence: Trigger, delivery and actual judgment evidence
audit.none: No completed MAIN strategic audit is recorded. Host checks do not stand in for one.
route.full: Complete route, task and audit links
p14.explicit_continue: Explicitly continue the same TRH Goal
p14.continue_instruction: The user explicitly selected Continue the same TRH Goal at P14, within the existing target and remaining allowance; preserve the selected P14 mode.
fdh.control: FDH discovery and D5 human choice
fdh.waiting: Formal D5 delivery is waiting for your choice. Requested native Goal pause and actual client synchronization are shown separately.
fdh.exploration: MAIN explores dynamically within D0. Ordinary reports and checkpoints do not constitute a formal D5 handover.
fdh.adoption_scope: Adoption binds one exact candidate. A TRH handoff creates a new paused instance with its own MAIN and Goal; it does not overwrite or automatically end this FDH.
fdh.continue: Continue discovery in the same FDH Goal
fdh.continue_instruction: The user explicitly requests CONTINUE_DISCOVERY within the unchanged D0 scope and remaining allowance, using the same FDH MAIN and Goal.
fdh.choose_candidate: Inspect exact candidates and choose a TRH handoff
fdh.keep_paused: You may keep this Goal paused without taking any action. Viewing candidates or discussing directions does not resume it.
fdh.end_instruction: The user explicitly selected End FDH exploration. Preserve candidates, unknown comparisons and actual mathematics; ending is not proof of goal success.
guidance.delivery_evidence: Original wording, replacements and actual delivery
audit.deadline_seconds: Next full audit at cumulative effective seconds
guidance.kind.QUESTION: Question
guidance.replacement_help: Select only directions you intend to replace or revoke. Original words remain preserved. To resume a paused Goal, use the explicit Continue control; discussion alone does not resume it.
audit.full_hours: Full strategic audit interval (effective research hours)
audit.policy_help: Defaults: 30 minutes and 4 effective research hours. Saving preserves elapsed research time and paused Goals. It does not select research stages, add calls, impose a task timeout or immediately run a model.
audit.interval_invalid: Each interval must convert to a positive whole number of seconds.
goal.identity_semantics: The native Goal is identified by its thread, creation time and original objective hash; this client does not expose a separate opaque Goal ID.
goal.observed_version: Control version at the saved native observation
goal.shared_streams_help: These original streams belong to this MAIN instance and may contain multiple requests, tool messages and control events. They are not a single task output. Each download includes every byte saved when it opens; later appends appear in the next download.
goal.no_streams: No native protocol or stderr stream has been saved for this instance yet.
recovery.help: An authorized software repair may allow one new billable MAIN request. The original request, rejected capture, errors and usage remain intact. This does not accept mathematical results, reset cumulative usage or add budget.
recovery.original_evidence: Open original request, output and native failure evidence
recovery.none: No execution maintenance recovery has been recorded.
round.historical_failure_help: These rejections remain in the record. Native evidence classifies them as no longer blocking the current work, through accepted repair, retirement or an authorized successor. This classification does not accept mathematics, certify goal completion or reset usage.
round.historical_open_help: The original duties remain OPEN in their native records. The backend classifies these execution duties as superseded by an actual authorized successor; it does not certify mathematical completion.
round.historical_waits: Historical wait evidence, no longer a current blocker
recovery.successor: Open the actual successor MAIN request
incident.not_current: The native applicability projection no longer classifies this record as a current blocker. The original status and error remain preserved.
incident.current_projection: Original incident fields and current applicability evidence
usage.internal_boundary: Each row is one thread’s observed cumulative counter; a reused thread may span multiple MAIN requests. Whether parent counters include child or descendant usage is unknown, so no cross-thread sum or addition to parent totals is shown. Internal threads consume no PMRS stage slots or top-level call allowance.
usage.no_thread_counters: No native internal thread counters have been observed. This does not establish zero delegation or zero usage.
usage.raw_evidence: Expand original usage records and evidence references
usage.coverage.COUNTER_OBSERVED_TERMINAL: Completed turns with an observed counter
view.load_failed: The selected view could not be loaded. Refresh to try again; the previous view is not shown under this heading.
